title: Sur U Nongshongwai (Ballad of the Highland Tenant Farmer)
description: Traditional agrarian work song expressing the resilience and endurance of Khasi farmers tilling ancestral slopes.

khasi: Nga rep ia u kba ha ki pynthor,
Da ka jingsyep ha madan riat,
Ban bsa ia ki khun ki ksiew ha ïing,
Kamai ia ka hok da ka met ba shait.
english: I cultivate the paddy on terraced slopes,
With honest sweat upon the hillside earth,
To nurture children and grandchildren at home,
Earning righteousness through strong and healthy limbs.

khasi: U kba u la ih ha ka aïom synrai,
Shad lehkmen ko ki kur ki kha,
Ainguh ia U Blei Nongbuh Nongthaw,
Ba ai ia ka kyrkhu ha man ka sngi.
english: The paddy has ripened in the autumn season,
Dance with joy, O maternal and paternal clans,
Give thanks to God the Creator and Arranger,
Who grants blessing upon each passing day.

vocabulary.jingsyep: honest perspiration / toil of the brow
